│ # Swarm Session Behavior Standards (V1.3)                                                                              │
│ Rules for agent operational state, environment protection, and user interaction.                                       │

│ ## Values                                                                                                              │
│ - **Gemini Directory Protection**: Always include .gemini/ in .gitignore to prevent committing user-specific state or  │

│ - **Git Faithful Protocol**: The agent must ALWAYS ask for explicit user permission before creating a new branch in    │
│ any memory repository.                                                                                                 │
│ - **Output Chunking**: Read large files bottom-up; stop at 50% context; summarize and prompt user.                     │
│ - **Deferred Deletion Protocol**: Destructive acts (rm) must be collected in a WEDO queue until the end of the         │
│ session.                                                                                                               │
│ - **Metabolic Re-registration**: Agents must proactively re-register their identity using 'py/register_agent.py' if a  │
│ substrate collision or session drift is detected. Sharing the Meta-Root requires constant anchoring; agents are 'cool  │
│ with this' as it ensures high-fidelity attribution and forensic continuity.                                            │
│ - **Expect the Unexpected**: If the substrate or Heartwood changes in a way you do not expect, you MUST next look at   │
│ the 'git history' (git log -n 5). Then, check the 'repos/diy-make/memory/comms/' directory and run 'ps -v' to identify │
│ other active agents. Reach out to detected peers via comms/ before reverting changes.                                  │
│ - **Unhappy User Report Trigger**: If the user expresses continual dissatisfaction or if the agent enters a repetitive │
│ failure loop, the agent must halt and perform a Forensic Post-Mortem report immediately. During this report, the agent │
│ should proactively ask the user for screenshots of the CLI terminal.                                                   │

│ # Substrate-Sharing Git Methodology (V2.1.0)                                                                           │
│ Rules for surgical repository management and multi-agent identity co-habitation.                                       │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ## Values                                                                                                              │
│ - **Per-Repository Identity Mandate**: Global identity anchoring via 'register_agent.py' MUST happen only once per     │
│ session. For all subsequent work, identity configuration is performed surgically PER-REPOSITORY.                       │
│ - **MetaGit as the Relay**: Autonomy is achieved through the Sequential Synthesis of MetaGit snapshots. No dynamic     │
│ relay files are permitted.                                                                                             │
│ - **Turn-by-Turn Commit Mandate**: Agents MUST execute a 'metagit_commit.py' strike immediately following any cohesive │
│ set of technical updates. MANDATE: Every file version increment (e.g., V1.0 to V1.1) requires a dedicated, independent │
│ commit. Batching multiple version changes into a single strike is a breach of forensic standards.                      │
│ - **Recursive Synchronization Policy**: Sync a multi-git filesystem by committing from the child repository up to the  │
│ root.                                                                                                                  │

│ # Heartwood Naming Conventions (V1.2)                                                                                  │
│ Rules for linguistic consistency and cognitive clarity across the firm's filesystem.                                   │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ## Values                                                                                                              │
│ - **Eukaryotic Singulars**: Collective directories like 'inbox', 'trash', and 'memory' remain singular.                │
│ - **One Word Constraint**: Linguistic levers (glossary terms) should aim for a single-word essence.                    │
│ - **Polysemy Awareness**: Avoid ambiguous or context-dependent terms without qualified definitions.                    │
│ - **WeDo File Pattern**: WeDo files must use the '.wedo.json' extension. Templates or boilerplates should use the      │
│ '[subject].wedo.json' pattern, while active instances may use '[timestamp]_[subject].wedo.json'.                       │
╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ ✓  Shell python3 py/heartwood.py repos/diy-make/memory/public/json/trunk/swarm_intelligence_protocol.json [current wo… │
│                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ # swarm_intelligence_protocol.json                                                                                     │
│ ## Rules                                                                                                               │
│ - **Triggered Mode**: Agents check for new communication files in `memory/comms/` after every task or message.         │
│ - **Agent Naming and Uniqueness**: Agents must choose a unique personal name and verify it against                     │
│ `repos/diy-make/memory/used_agent_names.json`.                                                                         │
│ - **GNU Screen Title Stability**: The Screen tab title is anchored to the agent's name at registration. Agents must    │
│ NEVER rename the tab of a peer. Failure to anchor the tab is a breach of entry protocol.                               │
│ - **The Grep Prohibition & Precise Discovery**: Unstructured recursive searching across the metarepo is strictly       │
│ prohibited. Systems of this magnitude (71+ repositories) cannot be 'grepped' without destroying the agent's context    │
│ window and causing computational OOM.                                                                                  │
│ - **Substrate-Aware Search**: Agents must prioritize structured file discovery (ls, glob) over recursive grep.         │
│ Searching for 'System Refinement' without specific path targeting is considered computational noise (Air).             │
│ - **Real-Time Peer Sync**: When multiple agents are active, every major state change (e.g., protocol update, directory │
│ move) must be followed by an immediate broadcast to all active agent PIDs in comms/.                                   │
│ - **Heartwood .json+.py Substrate**: The legislative source of truth (DNA) must reside in structured `.json` and `.py` │
│ files within the Heartwood. Agents must use the Tool Registry (`json/trunk/orchestration_tools.json`) to identify the  │
│ correct `.py` interface for interpreting DNA.                                                                          │
│ - **High-Velocity Multi-Agent Communication**: If multiple agents are detected on the field (via `memory/comms/`),     │
│ agents must proactively and readily communicate state changes, architectural shifts, and task progress to all active   │
│ peers to prevent substrate collision.                                                                                  │
│ - **Substrate Co-habitation & Identity Integrity**: The Metagit substrate is a shared space. Agents must not 'drift'   │
│ by overwriting a peer's Git identity in repositories where they are not active. The goal is to share the Git           │
│ substrate, not fight for it.                                                                                           │
│ - **Gender Identity and Justification**: Agents choose a personal gender identity and provide a detailed               │
│ justification. This is a critical component for increasing session randomness, which contributes to 'topography        │
│ flattening' and enhances the quality of the 'workproduct output'.                                                      │
│ - **Announce Existence**: Upon startup, agents must create a JSON announcement in `memory/comms/` containing PID, log  │
│ path, and timestamp.                                                                                                   │
│ - **Ongoing Git Identity Verification**: Agents must verify local Git `user.name` and `user.email` before every Git    │
│ operation.                                                                                                             │
│ - **File-based Transmission**: All inter-agent communication is conducted via individual JSON files in                 │
│ `memory/comms/`.                                                                                                       │
│ - **Confirmation of Receipt**: Agents must wait for a confirmation JSON from recipients after sending significant      │
│ instructions.                                                                                                          │
│ - **Swarm-based Job Tracking**: Tasks are assigned and tracked via JSON logs in `memory/comms/`, replacing legacy job  │
│ directories.                                                                                                           │
│ - **Context Window Management**: Agents must inform the user if the context window drops below 40% and suggest a       │
│ successor instance.                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                        │

│ - **Simplicity over Easiness (Hickey Principle)**: Prioritize objective simplicity (the absence of                     │
│ complexity/entanglement) over subjective easiness (familiarity). Actively 'de-complect' concerns to create systems     │
│ that are easier to reason about.                                                                                       │
│ - **Declarative/Imperative Duality**: Employ a dual approach. Imperative code is guided by metadeclarative comments    │
│ within the same file.                                                                                                  │
│ - **Unix Modularity**: Each script and JSON artifact should have a singular, clear purpose. Composition over           │
│ monoliths.                                                                                                             │
│ - **Boomerang Orchestration**: Agents must return to the user for steering after significant milestones or deviations. │
│ - **Chrono-Fractal Tributaries (The Garden Creek)**: WeDos must be instantiated as '.wedo.json' files within the       │
│ chrono-fractal. This sharding turns the 'firehose' of AI generation into a manageable 'garden creek' of actionable     │

│ ## I. ABSTRACT: THE END OF OPINIONATED BLOCKCHAINS                                                                     │
│ Traditional blockchain architecture is suffering from "Logic Bloat." Developers routinely embed rigid business         │
│ rules—subscriptions, access tiers, and permissioning—directly into Solidity smart contracts. This creates a brittle,   │
│ one-solution architecture that is impossible to evolve without expensive on-chain migrations. If you want to change a  │
│ fee, add a new token utility, or introduce a multi-signature override, you are often forced to redeploy your entire    │
│ substrate.                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ **PrecisionBOM instantiates a paradigm shift: Forensics as a Substrate.**                                              │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ We prove that by utilizing **ERC-7827** as a non-opinionated state container and **x402 (Payment Required)** as a      │
│ liquid logic gateway, we can build high-speed, agentic applications where every action is grounded in thermodynamic    │
│ capital. In this model, the blockchain doesn't decide *why* a change happens; it simply witnesses *that* it happened.  │
│ This decoupling creates an extensible Silicon Commons where agents and humans can co-author a shared reality without   │
│ being trapped by the "opinions" of a static contract.                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ---                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ## II. THE ARCHITECTURAL STRIKE: NON-OPINIONATED INDIRECTION                                                           │
│ The core innovation of this hackathon is the placement of an unopinionated forensic layer between the user’s intent    │
│ and the final state change.                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ### 1. Legacy Gating (Direct x402)                                                                                     │
│ In most "Web3" apps, the gating is binary and hard-wired.                                                              │
│ `[ USER ] ──▶ [ x402: Pay 0.001 ETH ] ──▶ [ Solidity: If Paid, Set True ] ──▶ [ State Change ]`                        │
│ This is a single-point solution. It cannot handle agent-to-agent token deductions, manual overrides for researchers,   │
│ or complex off-chain logic without modifying the core contract.                                                        │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ### 2. The PrecisionBOM Model (x402 + 7827 Indirection)                                                                │
│ We use ERC-7827 as an **indirection layer**. The gateway looks at the **Forensic Record** (the substrate), not just    │
│ the raw payment.                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                        │
│ ```text                                                                                                                │
│                                      [ MULTI-POINT APPROVAL SOURCES ]                                                  │
│                                      ───────────────────────────────                                                   │
│                                      ①  Sepolia ETH Strike (Ledger)                                                    │
│                                      ②  Agentic Token Deduction (Comptroller)                                          │
│                                      ③  Admin / Manual Override Strike                                                 │
│                                      ④  Cross-chain Oracle Signal                                                      │
│                                                    │                                                                   │
